item.description: By: Franklin ASARE-DONKOH Ghana’s apex court, the Supreme Court (SC), has dismissed an application filed by the Attorney-General, requesting the court to review a key aspect of its earlier ruling in the criminal trial of former Director General of the National Signals Bureau (NSB), Kwabena Adu Boahene, and his wife, Angela Adjei-Boateng. item.title: GJA President urges IGP to act over attack on Class FM journalist
item.description: By Love Wilhelmina Abanonave The President of the Ghana Journalists Association (GJA), Albert Kwabena Dwumfour, has called on the Inspector-General of Police (IGP), Christian Tetteh Yohuno, to take decisive action against officers involved in the Akwatia by-election violence, during which journalists were attacked. item.description: By Sarah Baafi The Minister for Works, Housing and Water Resources, Kenneth Gilbert Adjei, has outlined significant progress under the Greater Accra Resilient and Integrated Development (GARID) Project, as government intensifies efforts to reduce perennial flooding in the capital.
